steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each supported person is placed by their support this month and their placement date.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 person has no support recorded this month

findings.title: Person with no support recorded this month
findings.fix: Record the support or check the contact

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] person-p02.md:12  Person with no support recorded this month.
       Fix: Record the support or check the contact.
[medium] placement-log.csv:19  Placement with no date.
       Fix: Record the placement date.
[low] person-p04.md:26  Support record without a date.
       Fix: Date the record.
Not checked: The quality of the support.
pros: Checks a person with no support recorded for a month, and a placement with no date.
cons: Not checked: The quality of the support.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hrc-outplacement-tracker skill on the records for this review.
